name: rolling-edition
description: Agent skills from Rolling Edition's books, each built from the book's current edition and versioned by it.

plugins.name: business-intelligence-with-agents
plugins.description: Agents that turn business questions into trusted insights, from your warehouse: layered context, governed metrics in a semantic layer, guarded SQL, answers that say when they can't be given, access rules the agent can't talk its way past, and evaluation on your own golden questions, served over MCP, all on DuckDB, sqlglot and MetricFlow.

plugins.name: data-governance-as-code
plugins.description: Governing a data platform with code that runs in CI: a tested catalog, finding personal data, lineage from pipelines, access policies enforced as row filters and column masks, erasure that removes data, an audit trail, and rules for data used by AI, on an online learning platform's Iceberg tables.

plugins.name: model-context-protocol-in-practice
plugins.description: Tools and data for agents, for engineers who know APIs: what MCP adds to an HTTP API and when it's the wrong choice, and how to design, build, secure, test and run MCP servers and clients on specification revision 2026-07-28 with the Python SDK, mcp 2.x, with a migration path from the 2025 revisions.

plugins.name: open-table-formats
plugins.description: How Iceberg, Delta Lake and DuckLake store a table, change it, clean it up, register it in a catalog and move it to another format, on one hourly pageviews table, with examples that run offline on a laptop.

plugins.name: primer-on-search-relevance
plugins.description: How search engines find and rank results, and how to measure whether a change helps: lexical, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking with learned models and LLMs, and judgments from people and LLMs, on a real product catalog.

plugins.name: time-series-forecasting
plugins.description: How to forecast demand a day ahead and check that the forecast holds up: baselines, backtests that never see the future, statistical models, one LightGBM model for all clients, totals that add up, and calibrated prediction intervals, on hourly electricity demand from thirty clients.

plugins.name: rolling-edition
plugins.description: Every book's procedures in one plugin, with the MCP server
